description: Create clear architecture, flow, sequence, database, and user-journey diagrams from plain-language descriptions.

defaultPrompt: Create a sequence diagram for this API flow.
Turn this data model into an ERD.
interface.longDescription: Diagram Generator converts requirements, code context, and system descriptions into readable diagrams. It selects an appropriate diagram type, produces renderable Mermaid by default, and supports architecture, flowchart, sequence, ERD, state, timeline, mind map, deployment, and user-journey views.

name: diagram-generator
